issues.title: Bangladesh Bank website still offline over global PHP security vulnerability
issues.title_en: Bangladesh Bank website still offline over global PHP security vulnerability
issues.summary: The central bank has remained offline since 22 October as technical teams assess PHP security flaws that could expose servers and sensitive data to cyberattacks.
